OSINT difensivo: controlla la tua impron: Defensive OSINT: check your digital footprint on social media and assess your online exposure, in line with the GDPR.
L'OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) è la: OSINT (open-source intelligence) is the collection of information from public sources. Here you use it defensively: to understand what can be found online about you and to reduce your exposure. For the technical analysis of a domain use Domain reconnaissance and TLS certificate.
Usa questi strumenti su di te, sui tuoi: Use these tools on yourself, on your own accounts or with the written consent of the person concerned. Collecting and cross-referencing data about private individuals without a legal basis breaches the GDPR (Articles 6 and 14), and doxxing is forbidden. Read Ethics and law before you start.
Su quali piattaforme compare il tuo user: Which platforms your username appears on, which public metadata it exposes and whether your account email appears in known data breaches.
Checklist privata con punteggio e consig: A private checklist with a score and advice, searches about yourself and public-figure profiles from Wikidata.
